headlines.title: Trump hits International Criminal Court with sanctions after Nobel goes to former judge
headlines.summary: The sanctions are aimed at cutting the ICC off from the global financial system and include threats of punishment for countries that do business with the court.

headlines.summary: The amount is small compared with U.S. demand, but the deal aligns the U.S. with Russia and against Ukraine’s efforts to bomb Russian refineries.

headlines.summary: The secretary of state, in a meeting with Venezuelan opposition figure Dinorah Figuera, expressed U.S. support for talks meant to set the stage for elections.

headlines.title: Navi Pillay, leading human rights jurist, awarded Nobel Peace Prize
headlines.summary: The trailblazing South African human rights lawyer and International Criminal Court judge was recognized for her work “ensuring that war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide are prosecuted.”

headlines.title: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
headlines.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

headlines.title: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
headlines.summary: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
headlines.summary: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

headlines.title: The U.S. last held a public execution in the 1930s. The Pentagon wants to change that
headlines.summary: The Pentagon says it will livestream the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan at Fort Hood, the site of his 2009 mass shooting. That would be the first public execution in the U.S. since the 1930s.

headlines.title: U.S. working to reverse an Egyptian man's third-country deportation to Africa
headlines.summary: The Trump administration's effort to return Ahmed Soliman to the U.S. come after an Arizona judge said his deportation violated due process.

headlines.title: Experts chart practical ways for AI dialogue
headlines.summary: Experts at a Brookings Institution discussion on Tuesday pointed to technical exchanges, safety testing and communication over artificial intelligence-related incidents as practical areas where China and the United States could begin building a more sustained dialogue, even as competition between the two countries in advanced AI continues.

headlines.title: China, EU agree on steps to stabilize trade ties
headlines.summary: China and the European Union have agreed on a package of measures to ease trade frictions, improve market access and strengthen the stability of industrial and supply chains, according to a joint statement released by China's Ministry of Commerce on Friday, as the two sides sought to manage differences and build a more stable and balanced economic relationship.

headlines.title: 7.2-magnitude earthquake strikes Panama
headlines.summary: PANAMA CITY -- A 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck Panama on Friday, with its epicenter 39 kilometers northwest of Tonosi, a town in Los Santos province, according to a revised report from the University of Panama's Institute of Geosciences.

headlines.title: Beekeeping expertise benefits Kenyans
headlines.summary: NAIROBI — Grace Cheserem, chairwoman of the Lelkolo women's group in Kenya's Baringo County, still remembers her first honey harvest in 2022.

headlines.title: US-Canada trade dispute rumbles on
headlines.summary: A US ban on nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian imports has done little to ease a trade dispute between the two countries, analysts said, with talks showing limited progress and US President Donald Trump saying he is in no rush to resume negotiations.
